name: American BBQ: Bacon Wrapped Jalapeno Poppers
description: Jalapenos stuffed with cream cheese, feta, tasty cheese and lime, wrapped in bacon and either smoked over cherrywood or roasted on the BBQ.

itemListElement.text: Pre-heat the BBQ to hot, or prepare it by lighting charcoal or heating the box. Cooking temperature should be around 120-160°C. Wait until the charcoal ashes over, stir, then pile for indirect cooking. If using an indirect smoke box, start the fire in the box and add dry hickory to begin. Use only a small line of charcoal in the main BBQ cavity.
Cut the top off each jalapeno just below the stem, then slice the jalapenos in half lengthwise.
Using a small paring knife, scrape out the seeds and veins. (Chef's tip: always wash your hands after handling jalapenos.)
For the filling, mix the cream cheese, feta, tasty cheese and lime zest and juice until well combined, and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the filling into the middle of the jalapeno and join the two halves back together.
Cut the bacon in half, wrap it tightly around each jalapeno and fix it in place with a toothpick.
Smoking method (optional, but gives the best flavour and the most moisture retention): smoke the poppers at 200-250°F (about 95-120°C) for two hours using cherrywood.

BBQ method: place the poppers in the centre of the BBQ with the middle burners off and the side burners on medium, close the lid and roast for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the bacon is crispy and the chilli is soft.
Arrange on a serving platter with lime wedges.
